articles.title: Ukraine’s F-16 jets were starved of US-made missiles for weeks
articles.summary: Ukrainian F-16 fighter jets reportedly suffered a critical missile shortage for over three weeks, severely hampering their ability to counter Russian drones and missiles. Supplies from Kyiv's international partners had dried up precisely as Moscow was preparing a major offensive. This incident underscores the significant logistical and strategic challenges faced by Ukraine in sustaining its air defence capabilities amidst the ongoing conflict.

articles.title: Iran denies firing missile towards Turkiye after NATO interception
articles.summary: Iran's Armed Forces have vehemently denied allegations of firing any missiles towards Turkish territory. Via state media, they emphasized Iran's deep respect for Turkiye's sovereignty, refuting claims of military action. This statement clarifies Iran's stance amidst regional geopolitical tensions, reiterating its commitment to maintaining peaceful relations and respecting its neighbor's territorial integrity, addressing reports of potential engagement.
